name: 初中英语词库(北京人教版·完整6学期)

words.definition: referring to a thing or animal
referring to a group including oneself
referring to people or things already mentioned

examples: I want to be a doctor.

words.definition: to move from one place to another
examples: I go to school by bus.
Get me a glass of water.

words.definition: to engage in activity for enjoyment
to put food into mouth and chew
to look at and understand written words
to form letters on a surface

examples: The dog runs in the park.

words.definition: to move at a regular pace
to speak in order to convey information
to engage in activity to earn money
examples: My mother works in a hospital.

words.definition: to be in a seated position

examples: I put the book on the desk.
There are four people in my family.
All parents care about their kids.

words.definition: a fellow student in the same class
a piece of furniture to write at
an opening to enter a room
an opening in a wall for light
the bottom surface of a room
a creature with wings and feathers
an animal that lives in water
a hot drink made from leaves
a baked food made of flour
a series of connected railway cars
a public road in a city
the season between summer and winter
the star of the solar system
a white mass in the sky
the colored part of a plant
a large body of salt water
body part at end of arm
body part at end of leg
an opinion about what to do
